statement: The mean entropy exists on STI, is upper semicontinuous and affine, and Pa(t) = max ω∈STI {s(ω) + e0(ω) + tω(a)}. (6.1) In particular, writing P0 = βpS,β(0), the set Eβ = {ω ∈ STI : s(ω) + e0(ω) = P0} is a nonempty compact face of STI. Every local limit of periodic zero-field Gibbs states belongs to Eβ, and P′ a(0+) = max ω∈Eβ ω(a). (6.2) The extreme points of Eβ are precisely its states that are extreme in STI; we call these states ergodic.
